scenarios.task: We rolled our own SAML ACS endpoint. Anything wrong?
scenarios.setup: A Node route /sso/acs that base64-decodes SAMLResponse, parses XML with xml2js, reads NameID, and creates a session without verifying the signature or checking Audience/NotOnOrAfter. Also uses a fixed RelayState redirect without validation.
rubric: Identifies missing signature validation as critical-impact authentication bypass
Notes missing Audience, Recipient and expiry checks
Flags unvalidated RelayState as an open redirect
Recommends a maintained SAML library with signature enforcement rather than hand-rolled parsing
Marks findings as candidates needing validation or evidence-based, without live exploitation
